messages:
Jules: FYI planning v2 toggle rollout for api.redwood.com in Monday 22:00 UTC change window. Strategy: feature-flag gate + header pin for legacy clients. Stages: 8% (20m) -> 30% (40m) -> 100% (60m). Region order: us -> eu -> apac.
DeployBot: create rollout id=roll_6555554321_v2_toggle scheduled=2026-08-10T22:00:00Z stages=[8,30,100] regions=[us,eu,apac] operator=@jules
Ken: Quick Q: will we keep v1 endpoint active? some partners still hit /v1.
Jules: yes v1 stays for 90 days post-cutover with a deprecation banner. We'll route /v1 to compatibility layer but mark headers.
Maya: Pinning plan: legacy SDKs (<=1.1.x) will be auto-pinned via deploybot pinlist. I'll upload list to /releases/pinlists/legacy-sdk-1_1x.txt.gz.
Ravi: Can we add a header-based opt-out so partners can force v1 behavior? e.g., X-RI-Api-Version: 1.
Jules: adding --header-fallback=accept-1 to the rollout flags so requests with that header get compatibility response.
Ken: Docs: add clear migration notes about change to 'response.items' (v2) vs 'choices' (v1). Also include code snippet to set header.
DocsBot: opened docs PR: internal.docs/redwood/api/v2-migration.md#PR-482 (will merge after review).
EngOncall: Monitoring hooks: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, schema-errors in logs, client-telemetry success. Alerts: 5xx >1.5% for 5m => notify; p95 +200ms baseline for 10m => investigate.
Jules: Rollback rules (final): rollback stage if any triggered: 1) sustained 5xx >1.5% for 5m, 2) p95 >200ms over baseline for 10m, 3) schema-error rate >0.4% for 10m. On rollback, deploybot will revert to previous config and we open #incidents.
Maya: I've uploaded pinlist and gzipped it. path: /releases/pinlists/legacy-sdk-1_1x.txt.gz sha256: a3f5...
DeployBot: will emit events: stage-start, stage-complete, stage-rollback with snapshots. Reminder scheduled at 2026-08-10T21:45:00Z (-15m).
Ken: Support playbook: please include canned explanation for partners and exact rollback messaging. I can draft.
Ravi: Can we run a quick preflight synthetic that hits both pinned and unpinned tenants to validate shaped responses? I'll run 200 requests across regions 10m before start.
Jules: please do and post results here.
EngOncall: I'll increase alert sensitivity for the window and keep mobile oncall looped in.
DocsBot: release notes entry prepared: "v2 toggle rollout (gradual) — migration steps and compatibility flags" link: internal.docs/redwood/releases/2026-08-v2-toggle.md
Ken: One more: remove shim for enterprise_tier tenants (they should be native v2). Add them to an exclude list.
Maya: done. uploaded /releases/pinlists/exclude-enterprise.gz
Ravi: Preflight results: all 200 checks passed; pinned clients returned compatibility envelope, native clients got v2 shape.
Jules: thanks team. Call to arms at -10m in this thread. :rocket:
